senses.gloss: f. (קהי) what blunts or loosens the teeth, weakening; fig. (v. Mekh. Bo 18, end) refutation, arguments. Pl. אַקְוָותָא.
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 110b:12">Yeb. 110ᵇ</cite> <he>יתבי וקמקוו א׳</he> (Rashi Var. <he>מקהו אַקְהָתָא</he>) they were sitting and raising arguments. Cmp. <cite ref="A02894"><he>אַקְהָיוּתָא</he></cite>.
